title: Settlement Authority Matrix, Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
This matrix fixes, for each Deficiency Resolution Band, the settlement limits within which a representative may offer to settle a Deficiency Balance Account for less than its balance, and the settlement terms that follow acceptance.

| Term | Band 1 | Band 2 | Band 3 | Band 4 | Band 5 | Band 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowest lump-sum settlement a representative may offer, percent of the balance on the offer date | 60.0% | 55.0% | 50.0% | 45.0% | 40.0% | 35.0% |
| Lowest installment settlement a representative may offer, percent of the balance on the offer date | 70.0% | 65.0% | 60.0% | 55.0% | 50.0% | 45.0% |
| Smallest settlement amount accepted whatever the percent, USD (when the floor exceeds the balance the full balance is due) | $250.00 | $500.00 | $750.00 | $1000.00 | $1500.00 | $2000.00 |
| Maximum monthly installments in an installment settlement | 3 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Calendar days a settlement offer stays open for acceptance | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Calendar days after acceptance by which a lump-sum settlement must be paid | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Additional percentage points below the minimum settlement percent allowed with documented hardship | 5.0 | 5.0 | 5.0 | 10.0 | 10.0 | 10.0 |
| Calendar days after a broken settlement before a new settlement offer may be made | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Minimum calendar days after the opening date before a settlement offer may be made | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 60 |
| Forgiven amount at or above which an IRS Form 1099-C is issued for the year of the settlement, USD | $600.00 | $600.00 | $600.00 | $600.00 | $600.00 | $600.00 |
| Calendar days after the final settlement payment within which the settled-in-full letter is mailed | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

**Documents that establish hardship** (all six bands): a Social Security award letter; a state unemployment benefit determination; a physician's medical disability statement.

**Cadence of installment-settlement payments** (all six bands): monthly on the day of month of acceptance (28th when acceptance falls on the 29th-31st).

## Notes to the matrix

- The percent limits are read against the balance on the offer date and the band of the account; the floor applies whatever the percent produces, and when the floor exceeds the balance the full balance is due.
- With one of the three hardship documents, the band's minimum percent is lowered by the band's additional points: in Band 4, for instance, the lowest lump-sum percent becomes 35.0% and the lowest installment-settlement percent 45.0%.
- A settlement minimum-days figure of 0 means a settlement may be offered from the opening date itself; in Band 3 a settlement may first be offered on the 30th calendar day after opening.
- The Form 1099-C figure is reached at equality: a hypothetical forgiven amount of exactly $600.00 is reported, one of $599.99 is not.
